project.description:
ZFIN-10025: unified GO load. Imports GO Central's single MOD-ID-keyed DANRE-mod GPAD file, which is intended to replace the separate Load-GAF-GOA_m, Load-GPAD-Noctua_w, and Load-GAF-FP-Inference_m loads.
*** THIS JOB WRITES TO THE DATABASE BY DEFAULT *** (GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY defaults to false.) Left as-is it will add/update/remove marker_go_term_evidence rows for the GOA and Noctua organizations. Tick GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY for a dry run that only produces the QC report.
Captures before/after marker_go_term_evidence snapshots and a DB-level csvDiff for FIVE organizations: the three the load owns (GOA, Noctua, PAINT) plus the two it must NOT touch (FP Inferences, UniProt). The latter two are expected to diff 0/0; capturing them turns that assumption into a check, and documents the two known cutover gaps -- FP-Inference rows are orphaned rather than migrated, and the UniProt-org *2go rows (111,089 across all three streams) sit outside the removal scope, so the 70,062 interpro2go/ec2go ones would duplicate at cutover unless purged (see server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad/README-danre-mod-consolidation.md).
Exit code 2 from the load means "completed with errors" and is mapped to UNSTABLE, not FAILURE — a run with errors is normal, not an abort.
*** THIS JOB IS DISABLED UNTIL CUTOVER. *** Enabling it is HALF of a two-part switch and must not be done on its own. The other half is turning the UniProt-Secondary load's *2go GO streams OFF (LOAD_INTERPRO2GO_EC2GO=false, LOAD_KW2GO=false on UniProt-Secondary-Term-Load) and purging the pre-existing UniProt-org interpro2go + ec2go rows (70,062). Note the purge deliberately does NOT include kw2go (41,027), which has no successor -- that is a separate decision. Enable this job while those streams are still on and the same InterPro2GO/EC2GO content exists twice, under two different organizations — the secondary load owns its copies as gafOrganization='UniProt' and this load writes its own as 'GOA', so neither prunes the other. Enable it, flip those flags and run the purge together. See server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad/README-danre-mod-consolidation.md, open decisions 3 and 4.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: DANRE_MOD_GPAD_URL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: GPAD 2.0 source file. Default is GO Central's published prod file. Override to QC a candidate release before it is promoted, e.g. a file under https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/contrib/goa/goex/current/gpad/. file:// is not supported; the loader queries Last-Modified over HTTP.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: If checked, compute the add/update/remove diff and write the QC reports but perform NO database writes. Leave unchecked for a real load. Note: with this checked the before/after snapshots are identical, so the per-org csvDiff workbooks come out empty by design.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: If checked, run cleanMarkerGoTermEvidenceDuplicatesTask after the load and before the "after" snapshot is captured, so the diff reflects the post-cleanup state. Matches Load-GAF-GOA_m. No-op when GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY is checked, since nothing was written.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: MGTE_CLEANUP_CSVS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: If checked (the default), the cleanup writes its four record-keeping CSVs to server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad/Load-GPAD-GO-Central_m-dbdiff/ under the deployment root -- the same directory this job already puts its before/after mgte_*.csv snapshots and mgte_dbdiff_*.xlsx comparison workbooks in, and which is archived with the build. The CSVs are the record of which duplicate annotations the cleanup deleted. Uncheck when this run is a step in a larger comparison and they are just bulky byproducts. Has no effect unless RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP is also checked.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -e # BEFORE snapshot. GOA + Noctua are the orgs this load owns and mutates; FP Inferences + # UniProt are captured because it must NOT touch them -- their 0/0 diffs are the standing # check on the two known cutover gaps (see the job description). SQL=$SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad OUT=$TARGETROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad/Load-GPAD-GO-Central_m-dbdiff
echo "DANRE_MOD_GPAD_URL = $DANRE_MOD_GPAD_URL" echo "GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY = $GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY" echo "RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP = $RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP"
bash $SQL/mgte_snapshot.sh before "$OUT" --others GOA Noctua PAINT "FP Inferences" UniProt

set -e # Optional: run the marker_go_term_evidence duplicate cleanup after the load, before # the AFTER snapshot, so the diff reflects the post-cleanup state. Mirrors Load-GAF-GOA_m. # The task's record-keeping CSVs are written by \copy with relative paths, i.e. into the CWD, # which would be $SOURCEROOT. MGTE_CLEANUP_CSVS decides: checked -> -DcleanupCsvDir sends them # to the -dbdiff dir to be archived with the build; unchecked -> the flag is omitted and the # task writes none. if [ "$RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP" = "true" ]; then if [ "$GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY" = "true" ]; then echo "GAF_LOAD_REPORT_ONLY=true -> nothing was written; skipping cleanup" else echo "RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP=true -> running cleanMarkerGoTermEvidenceDuplicatesTask" cd $SOURCEROOT # -DcleanupCsvDir names where the record-keeping CSVs go; omitting it skips them. if [ "$MGTE_CLEANUP_CSVS" = "false" ]; then CLEANUP_CSV_ARG="" else CLEANUP_CSV_ARG="-DcleanupCsvDir=$TARGETROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad/Load-GPAD-GO-Central_m-dbdiff" fi echo "MGTE_CLEANUP_CSVS=$MGTE_CLEANUP_CSVS -> ${CLEANUP_CSV_ARG:-(no CSVs)}" gradle cleanMarkerGoTermEvidenceDuplicatesTask $CLEANUP_CSV_ARG fi else echo "RUN_MGTE_CLEANUP not true -> skipping cleanup" fi

set -e # AFTER snapshot + per-org row-level diff. SQL=$SOURCEROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad OUT=$TARGETROOT/server_apps/DB_maintenance/gafLoad/Load-GPAD-GO-Central_m-dbdiff
bash $SQL/mgte_snapshot.sh after "$OUT" --others GOA Noctua PAINT "FP Inferences" UniProt bash $SQL/mgte_csvdiff.sh "$OUT" --others GOA Noctua PAINT "FP Inferences" UniProt
